fact: The regulator's report for the second quarter of 2025 gives a weighted average mobile internet tariff of 0.55 CFA francs a megabyte across MTN and Airtel, down 23.6 per cent from the second quarter of 2024.
title: Observatoire du marché de l'Internet mobile, rapport du 2e trimestre 2025
publisher: Agence de Régulation des Postes et des Communications Électroniques (ARPCE)
